[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] '''Careese''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] along with her husband, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]]. The pair had a daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Aereena]].
